HOLOTHEME.Setting.Name: Foundry window theme
HOLOTHEME.Setting.Hint: Give Foundry's own windows the Holo-Terminal look (SW5e Database colours): settings, dialogs, dnd5e item sheets and dialogs, the Escape menu, context menus and tooltips. Whole interface also themes the sidebar, chat, hotbar and scene navigation.
HOLOTHEME.Skip.Name: Foundry window theme: skip these windows
HOLOTHEME.Skip.Hint: CSS selectors (comma separated) for windows that should keep their own look, for example another module's window that doesn't read well themed.
